[h1]NEW ENDGAME: CRUSADES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Crusades are the new primary endgame activity, replacing existing difficulty levels, Invasions, and the Raid tab. They offer progressively challenging content and scaling rewards.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/1ff97392109a2105b44f4762e0922525df0893b8.png[/img]

[h2]Unlocking Crusades[/h2]
[list]
[*] Available after completing the campaign via the Crusade Obelisk in town.
[/list]

[h2]Progression[/h2]
[list]
[*] Crusades consist of 11 Tiers.
[*] Higher Tiers increase enemy level, health, damage, and grant base Magic Find.
[*] New maps unlock with each Tier progression. Act Boss maps become available from Tiers 8-11.
[/list]

[h2]Crusadium Currency[/h2]
[list]
[*] A new currency used to run Crusade maps and apply modifiers.
[*] [b]Earning Crusadium:[/b] Defeat bosses level 30+, defeat Crusade map bosses, and complete minidungeons. Higher Tier bosses award exponentially more Crusadium. Minidungeon bosses grant 50% of the normal Crusadium reward.
[*] [b]Using Crusadium:[/b] Spent to select maps and add modifiers. Modifiers cannot be added if the cost exceeds available Crusadium needed to also start the map.
[/list]

[h2]Maps[/h2]
[list]
[*] Select a specific map or choose "Random".
[*] Selecting a random map grants +25% Crusadium Reward and randomizes the boss (or both bosses if the "Additional Boss" mod is active).
[*] Bosses are otherwise determined by the specific map selected.
[*] Completing a map unlocks it permanently for selection across all unlocked Tiers.
[*] Changing the selected map retains any chosen modifiers.
[*] Changing the selected Tier resets all modifiers.
[*] Starting a map locks the configuration. Abandoning the map resets the Obelisk interface.
[/list]

[h2]Modifiers[/h2]
[list]
[*] Add up to 4 Player Mods (penalties) and 4 Enemy Mods (increased difficulty) per map.
[*] Each Tier increase requires adding one additional modifier (Player or Enemy) compared to the previous Tier to unlock the next one.
[*] Mod costs and the base map cost double with each Tier increase.
[*] The severity/effect of modifiers increases with higher Tiers.
[*] Mods whose effects don't inherently scale (e.g., "Enemies are immune to Fire") instead grant increased Pack Size.
[/list]

[h2]Running Maps[/h2]
[list]
[*] Bosses encountered behind fog doors allow one attempt reset if the player fails.
[/list]

[h1]TALENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Talent trees are now capped at 30 points. Further points must go to another tree.
[/list]
[h2]New Talent Tree: Aetherion[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38206390/b01c110e19bb2866a3d79cc79031ed3548b2a30a.jpg[/img]
[h3]Tier 1[/h3]
[list]
[*] Wellspring: Mana Regen increased by 10%.
[*] Quickened Incantation: Spells gain 10% increased Cast Speed. If dual-wielding Focuses, this bonus is doubled.
[*] Scholar: Max Mana increased by 10%
[*] Arcane Duplication: Projectiles have a 15% chance to gain Lesser Wildshot.
[/list]
[h3]Tier 2[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mana Frenzy: On Spell Hit: 15% chance to gain mana Frenzy, increasing Mana Regen by 50% for 3 seconds.
[*] Arcane Momentum: Casting a Spell grants 1 stack of Momentum Charge. At 3 stacks, gain Arcane Momentum. Arcane Momentum grants 100% increased Cooldown Speed, 50% Attack and Cast Speed, and 50% Charge Speed for 4 seconds.
[*] Spell Sniper: Projectile Spells gain 20% increased damage, 35% increased range, and 50% increased speed.
[*] Aetherflow: Damaging skills consume 20% less Mana. 50% chance on Hit to inflict Arcane Resonance. Total Damage reduced by 20%.
[/list]
[h3]Super - Aetherion’s Barrage[/h3]
[list]
[*] For 10 seconds, Mana Regeneration, Cooldown Reduction, and Ability Charge Speed increased by 25%. Cooldown Reduction cap increased to 75%. Your Dodge Roll becomes a Blink.
[/list]

[h2]Kirkira Tree Rework[/h2]
[h3]Tier 1[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mystic Impact: Spells deal 15% more Resilience Damage.
[*] Cataclysmic Casting: Area Effects from damaging skills that cost Mana are 15% larger.
[*] The Severance: Gain Mana equal to your Stamina. Lose half of Stamina.
[*] Potent Mana: Spells gain additional base damage equal to 5% of your Maximum Mana.
[/list]
[h3]Tier 2[/h3]
[list]
[*] Annihilation: Area Effects are 35% larger and deal 20% more damage. Area bonus increased to 50% while wielding a Staff.
[*] Ultimate Arcanum: Damaging skills that cost Mana consume 20% more Mana and deal 40% more damage.
[*] Concentrated Spell: Area effects from damaging skills that cost Mana are 25% smaller and deal 40% more damage. Damage bonus increased to 50% while wielding a Staff.
[*] Familiar: Gain a familiar that floats around you and echoes your Spell Projectile casts at 30% damage. 1 second cooldown between spell casts.
[/list]
[h3]New Super - Singularity[/h3]
[list]
[*] Create a singularity that pulls in enemies and deals 100% spell damage per second for 6 seconds.
[/list]

[h2]Talent Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]VERNDARI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hunter’s Mark: Damage per stack: 3% → 4%.
[*] Aspect of the Wolf: 20% → 40% chance for your Hits to Hit an additional time for 100% -> 30% of the damage.
[*] Aspect of the Razorcat: 20 → 25% chance on hit to Bleed the target for 100% of the damage inflicted and gain 1 stack of Feral Momentum.
[*] Verndari CDR Passive: 1% → 1.5% per point.
[/list]
[h3]EHTIRAS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spellblade: 15% of damage you deal with Spells is stored in your melee weapon. Melee attacks deal double damage until stored damage is expended. While wielding a focus, 50% of damage you deal with spells is stored. [i]Dev note: This is unchanged for Focus + 1H Melee loadouts, but now works with 2H melee weapons if you also grab Innate Magic for the ability to cast Spells (at the 15% rate).[/i]
[*] Godcaller: On Hit: 30% chance to summon a lightning bolt that deals an additional 50 → 70% damage. (Previously reduced 100%->70%, now buffed)
[*] Arcane Resilience is now Arcane Barrier - Deals up to 50% Combined Weapon Damage as Spell Damage around you when destroyed.
[*] Focus implicit/explicit mods related to Ehtiras now grant Spell Damage (clarification or change from previous 'Focus Damage').
[/list]
[h3]CERRIDWEN[/h3]
[list]
[*] Mutual Mending: Added: While you are at Full Health, your Health Flasks heal your Pact Minion for an additional 50%.
[*] Master’s Aura: Gain an aura that causes nearby minions to deal 25% → 30% more damage and take 15% → 20% less damage.
[/list]
[h3]SENDATU[/h3]
[list]
[*] Talented Healer: Using your Health Flask also heals all nearby allies for 20% → 25% of their Maximum Health.
[*] Sendatu Magic Find Passive replaced with Wisdom (Boon Intensity + Mana).
[/list]
[h3]ASTAROTH[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unified Front:
[list]
[*] Your Melee Hits inflict a mark on the target which detonates when Hit by your Pact Forgeborne, increasing the Hit's damage by 30% → 35%.
[*] Your Pact Forgeborne's Hits also mark targets, which your Melee Hits can detonate to increase their damage by 30% → 35%.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]VALKYRION[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pressure Points: While Unarmed, physical attacks deal additional Resilience Damage equal to 5% → 10% of your Critical Strike Chance. Maximum 10 additional Resilience Damage.
[/list]
[h3]ZABAOTH[/h3]
[list]
[*] Unyielding
[list]
[*] Old: Gain 5% Damage Resistance for each 100 Health you are missing, up to 40%.
[*] New: Gain 1% Damage Resistance for each 50 Health you are missing, up to 30%.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]ORIAS[/h3]
[list]
[*] Heavy Shielding: Block bonus reduced 15% → 10%. Attack Speed penalty removed. Now adds a 10% movement speed penalty while blocking (stacks with the base 20% penalty from blocking with a shield).
[*] Reinforcement Talent (Orias tree): Resilience Damage reduction from Blocked Hits reduced 50% → 30%.
[/list]


[h1]SKILLS[/h1]

[h2]General Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Max 5 ultimates with the new level cap.
[*] Some skill requirements now read "Requires a martial weapon equipped," martial weapons include swords, axes, maces, bows, and crossbows.
[*] Changed unarmed heavy attack to a single strike.
[/list]

[h2]Reworks and Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Charged Effect[/h3]
[list]
[*] When stacks of Charged are consumed, targets are now inflicted with [b]Electrified[/b], causing all incoming Hits to have +30% Critical Strike Chance for 4 seconds.
[*] The damage dealt by the lightning bolt when consuming Charged has been reduced by 50%.
[*] Consuming Charged no longer counts as a Hit.
[/list]
[h3]Freeze Mechanics[/h3]
[list]
[*] When a target becomes Frozen, instead of becoming immune to further Freezes, their threshold to become Frozen increases by 50%. This allows Freeze to continue being relevant in long encounters without trivializing combat.
[*] Stacking Chills now contribute to Freeze with the final value of the Chill after stacking instead of the initial stacking value.
[*] Example: With a 5% stacking Chill that caps at 25%, OLD: 5% + 5% + 5% + 5%, etc., would require 20 hits to Freeze. NEW: 5% + 10% + 15% + 20% + 25% + 25% = Freeze, total of 6 hits.
[/list]
[h3]Poison Rework[/h3]
[list]
[*] Each stack of Poison deals 25% Combined Weapon Damage over 5 seconds and has an independent duration from other stacks. No stack limit.
[/list]
[h3]New Effect: Wicked Resonance[/h3]
[list]
[*] At 3 stacks of Wicked Resonance, consume all stacks to inflict a random Curse on the target for 6 seconds. Avoids Curses already active on the target. Targets that die with at least 1 stack of Wicked Resonance apply a random Curse to a nearby target or Desecrated Ground.
[/list]

[h2]New Crossbow Skills[/h2]
[h3]Adaptive Configuration[/h3]
(This skill is available while wielding a 2H Crossbow or dual-wielding 1H Crossbows)
[list]
[*] Cycle between three distinct crossbow firing configurations. Switching configurations is instant and does not cost resources.
[*] [b]Arbalest Configuration:[/b] Fires bolts that pierce through enemies, dealing 100% combined weapon damage to all enemies hit.
[*] [b]Blast Configuration:[/b] Blast enemies in a cone in front of you. Enemies closer to you take more damage, up to 100% combined weapon damage.
[*] [b]Gatling Configuration:[/b] Rapidly fires bolts that deal 70% combined weapon damage.
[/list]
[h3]Explosive Bolt[/h3]
[list]
[*] Stamina Cost: 150
[*] Mana Cost: 0 → 25
[*] Cooldown: 6s → 8 seconds
[*] Fires an explosive bolt that deals 125% combined weapon damage and knocks back Allies and Normal and Elite enemies.
[/list]
[h3]Clip Skills[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]General Mechanic:[/b]
[list]
[*] Clip skills load a clip of magical bolts into your Crossbow. Clips have various effects which are applied to targets hit by your Crossbow in any Configuration and increase base Bolt damage by 150% spread out over the number of bolts in the clip (clips with more bolts have a lower bonus damage per bolt). Clip skills all have the same Stamina Cost and Cooldown, and Mana cost equal to (112.5 + 12.5 per bolt). Only one Clip can be active at a time, adding a new clip will overwrite an existing one. While dual-wielding 1H Crossbows, the number of bolts granted by a clip is increased by 25%.
[*] Mana Cost: 112.5 + 12.5 per bolt, Stamina Cost: 75, Cooldown: 3 seconds.
[/list]
[*] [b]Clip Options:[/b]
[list]
[*] Inferno Clip: Load a clip of 3 bolts imbued with fire and inflict Burn on impact, dealing 25% combined weapon damage per second for 3 seconds. Burn stacks up to 75% combined weapon damage per second.
[*] Frostbite Clip: Load a clip of 6 bolts imbued with ice and inflict 20% Chill on impact.
[*] Charged Clip: Load a clip of 6 bolts imbued with lightning and inflict Charged on impact.
[*] Poison Clip: Load a clip of 5 bolts imbued with 2 stacks of Poison.
[*] Cursed Clip: Load a clip of 3 bolts imbued with Wicked Resonance. Bolts inflict 1 stack of Wicked Resonance for 4 seconds.
[*] Desecrating Clip: Load a single bolt imbued with Desecrated Ground.
[*] Chaos Clip: Load a clip of 7 bolts imbued with Chaos, each bolt gains the effects of a random clip.
[*] Arcane Clip: Load a clip of 3 bolts imbued with Arcane Resonance. (Arcane Clip’s Mana Cost is increased by 50%).
[/list]
[/list]

[/list]

[h1]ITEMS[/h1]
[h2]New Crafting Item: Echo Shards[/h2]
[list]
[*] Empty Echo Shards can now drop from bosses (drop rate significantly reduced/rarity increased).
[*] Echo Shard: Destroys an item with 4 explicit mods and randomly preserves one of the mods in a filled Echo Shard, which can apply the mod randomly to another item.
[*] Filled Echo Shards randomly overwrite an explicit mod on an item with the stored mod. If the level of the stored mod is higher than the level of the equipment it is applied to, the level of the mod will be reduced to match.
[*] Only mods retrieved from 2H weapons can be applied to other 2H weapons (Only 2H Echo Shards can be used on 2H Weapons).
[*] Echo Shards can now be used directly on equipped items.
[/list]

[h2]General Item Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Equipment and Runestones now roll at the level of either your character or the enemy, whichever is lower.
[*] [b]Sanctified Weapon implicit/mod:[/b] Resilience damage bonus reduced 50% → 25%.

notes.title: The Divine Update: Ascend Your Arsenal
notes.notes:
Fellow Knights,

As we stand on the threshold of a new era, I am thrilled to present to you "The Divine Update," a testament to our unyielding pursuit of greatness. This update ushers in a realm of new gameplay enhancements, new skills blessed by the divine, and a treasure trove of crafting items to forge our destiny. We've refined our combat with the addition of lock-on for precision strikes and a crafting inventory which will allow us to fill our bags with even more spoils of war.

Embark on this journey with the divine as your guide. Harness the power of Divine Fury, explore the depths of our enhanced abilities, and stand united as we face the challenges ahead. May your blades strike true and your resolve be unbreakable.

Adventure awaits, fellow knights. To battle, to glory, and beyond.

Yours in valor,
Aeromir

(Also here's a [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vSQonffWp4DGaS4YTYJwaoSGSczNRWSHfezANEtJXKLcSEbcelmCLvsUYhhIovu-J-SS65-d_ouqkrW/pub]Google Doc of these notes[/url] for more convenient reading ːsteamthumbsupː)

[h1]NEW[/h1]
[h2]4 New Crafting Items[/h2]
[b]Weapon Sigil[/b] - Increases the quality of a weapon by 1%, increasing its base damage by the same amount. Max 10% quality.
[b]Armor Sigil[/b] - Increases the quality of armor by 1%, increasing implicit mod levels by 1. Max 10% quality.
[b]Favored Weapon Sigil[/b] - Increases the quality of a weapon by 1%, increasing its base damage by the same amount. Max 20% quality.
[b]Favored Armor Sigil[/b] - Increases the quality of armor by 1%, increasing implicit mod levels by 1. Max 20% quality.

[h2]Lock-On[/h2]
Players can now lock-on to enemies. (Default: Mouse Thumb Button/Right Thumbstick Button)

[h2]Out of Combat Regeneration[/h2]
Players and Companions now regenerate resources and cooldowns quickly while out of combat. No more need to stop and Meditate.

[h2]Crafting Inventory[/h2]
A new special inventory has been added next to the normal inventory. This inventory can house any number of crafting items and features an Auto Transfer button to quickly move all crafting items from your normal inventory into the crafting inventory. This new inventory is account-wide and accessible by all characters. Crafting items can be transferred between each inventory by shift-clicking. A new binding has been added to the Input menu to transfer all items at a key press (default: Comma).

You can now quickly set the skill in an action bar slot by right clicking the slot and selecting any of your available skills from the new menu.

[h2]Inspect[/h2]
You can now inspect your allies' gear by right-clicking their party portrait and selecting the new Inspect option.

[h2]Universal Penance[/h2]
Companions now use your Penance count

You can now swap between DX11, DX12, and Vulkan from the Video Settings menu (requires restart).

[h1]Primal Skills[/h1]
All Primal skills are either Primal Charge generators or spenders. Spender skills have no weapon requirements as these are powered by your accumulated Primal Charge. Primal Charge can only be gained while in combat and caps at 100 stacks. Generators can roll randomly on gear, but Spenders must be purchased from the Skill Merchant.

[h1]Transformation Skills[/h1]
Gain "Animus Lock" for three seconds after entering a transformation: "The rush of feral instincts from your recent transformation demands you hold onto this form. Cannot change form."

Instant cast spells may be cast while transformed, as long as your normal form meets the weapon requirements for the skill. This includes most buffs, Shouts, Entanglements, Auras, Toggles like Bladecrest and Bloodrage, Blinks, Consecration, Flame Dash, Phase Shift, and probably a few more. Visiting the Skill Merchant while transformed and pressing the "Current Usable" button will show you all skills usable while transformed with your current equipment. [h3]Invasion Overhaul[/h3]
Invasions are now activated from the Obelisk in Town. The Obelisk also allows you to manually set your Invasion level based on the highest level of Invasion you've completed. Maps are no longer randomly invaded. The Obelisk will unlock after defeating the Act 4 Boss on Commander difficulty.

[h3]Difficulty Unlocks[/h3]
Both Captain and Commander difficulties are unlocked after completing the campaign on Normal difficulty. All enemies above Normal difficulty are level 30.

[i]Dev Note: The campaign is now long enough that new characters are level 30 upon completing it on Normal. Now it's up to you to determine what level of challenge you want instead of having to complete Captain difficulty first.[/i]

[h3]New Random Event - Mini-Dungeon[/h3]
Completing any random encounter has a small chance to spawn a portal to a mini dungeon with its own boss and treasure room. Every treasure room contains 4 chests, 1 of which contains a specific type of guaranteed loot. The type of loot is indicated by the color of the portal:

Blue: 2 Pieces of Enchanted Equipment
Orange: 1 Piece of Legendary Equipment
Red: 25 Runestones and 5 Favored Runestones
Yellow: 50 bags of Gold
Green: 10 of each non-Favored crafting item, chance for Favored crafting items

[*] Added a Wave emote

[/list]

[*] [b]Fortune [/b](2 points) - 50% Magic Find
[*] [b]Greater Fortune [/b](3 points) - 75% Magic Find
[/list]
[h2]ITEMS[/h2]
[h3]NEW LEGENDARIES - Global[/h3]
[b]Sendatu's Fury - 1H Sword[/b]
Bladecrest projectiles grant 1 stack of Divine Resonance on hit. At 20 stacks or after 3 seconds, the effect bursts, dealing 5% combined weapon damage per stack to all nearby targets. Damage area increases with stacks. Damage doubled while wielding two Sendatu's Fury.

[b]Sendatu's Grace - 1H Sword[/b]
Bladecrest projectiles grant 1 stack of Divine Resonance on hit. At 20 stacks or after 3 seconds, the effect bursts, casting (Brutality/Haste/Precision/Lethality/Undying Will) on you and nearby allies at 1% increased Boon Intensity per stack. Bonus increased to 2% per stack while wielding two Sendatu's Grace.

[i]Dev Note: The boon assigned to Sendatu's Grace is randomly rolled. Dual-wielding two Sendatu's Grace with different boons will apply both.[/i]

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
Enchant costs reduced by 50%.

[h2]TALENTS[/h2]

[b]New Talent: Aspect of the Razorcat [/b]- 20% chance on hit to Bleed the target for 100% of the damage inflicted and gain 1 stack of Feral Momentum. Killing a target grants 1 stack of Feral Momentum. Feral Momentum increases movement speed by 5% per stack for 6 seconds, up to 5 stacks.

notes.title: Upcoming Frontiers Update & Price Increase
notes.notes:
Knights,

It's with a blend of enthusiasm and gratitude that I present to you the details of another massive update: [b]The Frontiers Update[/b]. Before diving into the novel features, I want to address an imminent change: [b]the price of the game will be increasing soon[/b]. This adjustment reflects the extensive content and features I've added, and it's based on your invaluable feedback that I've been able to enhance our game's value.

[h1]What's Inside the Frontiers Update[/h1]

    [b]Maps Galore[/b]: Embark on journeys to new destinations such as Fort Ironhold, Ironhold Dungeon, The Giant Mines, Kharabad City, and more, as well as new unique enemies and bosses. This update adds 2 new Acts to the campaign.

    [b]Invasion Overhaul[/b]: Say goodbye to random map invasions! With the new Obelisk in Town, you can trigger Invasions and customize your Invasion level.

    [b]Revamped Gameplay Mechanics[/b]: From a redesigned skill bar to new item filters and more streamlined selling methods, I've worked diligently to smooth out the gameplay for you.

    [b]Discover the "Fortune" Flask Effect[/b]: Boost your chances of finding rare treasures and redefine your exploration strategies.

    [b]New Global Legendaries[/b]: The all-new Sendatu's Fury and Sendatu's Grace add new support and damage options for Bladecrest users.

    [b]Talent Transformations[/b]: Multiple talent trees have undergone major talent changes, both new and refined, to offer diverse choices and challenges.

    [b]Immersive Enhancements[/b]: With improved lighting, new skill icons, new sound FX, and more, I've aimed to make the environment even more engaging.

    [b]Fixes, Tweaks & More[/b]: Numerous bugs have been addressed to further improve the overall gaming experience.

[h1]Why the Price Increase?[/h1]

This update, a product of countless hours of work and passion, showcases many additions and improvements. In light of the expanded content and features, I believe it’s time to adjust the price to better reflect the game's value. The price will increase to $20 next week when the update goes live.

[h1]Let's Connect[/h1]

Make sure to join the [url=https://discord.gg/u5yq67Z]Discord[/url]! Your feedback drives this game's evolution. 

[h1]A Sincere Thank You[/h1]

It's thanks to each of you that I'm motivated to push the boundaries of game development. My hope is that you'll relish the content of The Frontiers Update as much as I've enjoyed crafting it for you. Lots more updates to come.

Warm regards,

Aeromir

[b]Bladesash [/b]- You ignore weapon requirements for Fan of Knives.

[b]Boulder Fauld [/b]- You ignore weapon requirements for Rockfist Stance.

[b]Secrets of Summoning Vol. I [/b]- Gain the effects of Volatile Summoning. If you already have Volatile Summoning allocated, it deals double damage.

[b]Secrets of Summoning Vol. II [/b]- Gain the effects of Forbidden Knowledge.

[b]Flameband [/b]- Your Burn effects last 20% longer.

[b]Sash of the Mountain [/b]- (Max Health/Max Mana/Max Stamina) increased by (5-10%).

[b]Trapper's Tools [/b]- You ignore weapon requirements for Trap skills.

[b]Giant's Girdle [/b]- Max Resilience increased by 10%.

[b]Hidden Remedy [/b]- Gain the effects of High-Capacity Flask.

[b]Prolonging Agent [/b]- Your Utility Flask gains the Increased Duration Flask Effect.

[b]Charismatic Wrap [/b]- You ignore weapon requirements for the granted Aura skill.

[b]Berserker Sash [/b]- Melee Hits restore 5 Health over 5 seconds while you are affected by Blood Rage.

[h2]BOOTS - 12[/h2]
[b]Kindlestep [/b]- Triples the width of Flame Dash.

[b]Crippling Steeltoes [/b]- Shield Charge reduces enemy damage output by 15% for 5 seconds.

[b]Elessar Striders [/b]- Gain 2 charges of Ranger's Agility. Dodging will consume 1 charge if available to dodge as if you had the Dash talent. Regain 1 lost charge every 5 seconds.

[b]Boots of Dimensional Travel [/b]- Blink skills create a portal for 5 seconds that allies can use to blink to your destination location. Spatial Instability duration increased by 50%.

[b]Tectonic Step [/b]- Earthquake pulls in nearby enemies.

[b]Indomitable Greaves [/b]- Your movement speed cannot be changed. Mobility skills have 25% longer cooldowns.

[b]Ferocious Sabatons [/b]- After hitting with Ruthless Charge, gain Haste for 3 seconds, increasing your Attack Speed by 10%.

[b]Swiftsteps [/b]- Gain the effects of Elusive.

[b]Resolute Greaves [/b]- Duration of Crowd Control effects on you is reduced by 30%.

[b]Forceful Tramplers [/b]- Gain Brutality for 4 seconds when you hit an enemy with Leap Smash.

[b]Feeding Frenzy [/b]- Feast has 50% increased effect when used on targets below 50% health.

[b]Subjugation Garb [/b]- Summons deal 50% increased damage with their first attack.

[h2]AMULETS - 5[/h2]
[b]Chain of Enchanting [/b]- Equipment drops from enemies are 50% more likely to be Enchanted.

[b]Chain of Renown [/b]- Equipment drops from enemies are 50% more likely to be Legendary.

[b]Chain of Wealth [/b]- Gold drops give 100% increased Gold.

[b]Chain of Crafting [/b]- Crafting Items drop 50% more often from enemies.

[b]Chain of Chance [/b]- Gamba drops give 50% increased Gamba.

[h2]RINGS - 6[/h2]
[b]Gambler's Ring [/b]- Gamba drops give 25% increased Gamba.

[b]Ring of Affluence [/b]- Gold drops give 50% increased Gold.

[b]Artisan's Ring [/b]- Crafting Items drop 25% more often from enemies.

[b]Circle of Influence [/b]- Equipment is 100% more likely to be influenced by this item's influence.

[b]Band of Armaments [/b]- Weapons are 100% more likely to be... (Ring randomly selects one of: One-Handed, Two-Handed, Swords, Axes, Maces, Shields, Bows, Focuses, or Staffs).
[i]Dev Note: This ring is particularly effective for target farming certain weapons as multiple rings can be stacked.[/i]

[b]Discerning Smithband [/b]-  Equipment is 100% more likely to be... (Ring randomly selects one of: Weapons, Helmets, Armors, Boots, Amulets, Rings, Gloves, or Belts).

[h2]WEAPONS - 31[/h2]
[b]Arachnoid [/b](1H Mace) - Spidermines inflict 1 stack of Charged for 3 seconds. Gaining 3 stacks of Charged consumes the effect to strike the target with lightning for 100% combined weapon damage. This effect does not stack.

[b]Ol' Reliable [/b](1H Mace) - Gain the effects of Quick Construction. If Quick Construction is allocated, its effect is increased by 50%.

[b]Binder's Lost Multitool [/b](Staff) - Gain the effects of Ingenuity. Ingenuity always applies to this weapon.

[b]Stormweaver [/b](Focus) - Thunderbolt has a 50% chance to inflict 1 stack of Charged for 3 seconds. Gaining 3 stacks of Charged consumes the effect to strike the target with lightning for 100% spell damage.

[b]The Ice Star [/b](Staff) - Ice Storm now last for 5 seconds, costs 250 mana, and cannot be channeled. Cooldown increased to 10 seconds.

[b]Bard's Harp [/b](Bow) - 50% of your Critical Strike Chance is gained as Boon Intensity.

[b]The Red Reception [/b](2H Axe) - Physical Hits Bleed for 15% of the damage inflicted. Bleed effects deal damage 30% faster.

[b]Torment [/b](2H Sword) - Physical Hits Bleed for 15% of the damage inflicted. Bleed effects now deal their full damage over 10 seconds instead of 5. All Bleed damage increased by 15%.

[b]Staff of Bombardment [/b]- Meteor now summons 3 moderately accurate meteors and cannot be supported by Wildshot. Meteors now inflict a 10% Burn.

[b]Might of the Divine [/b](2H Mace) - Inflicting Hitstun spawns a Divine Hammer.

[b]Vessel of The Caustic Fang [/b](Focus) - Summoned Spiders inflict 1 stack of Poison on hit. Poison damage now only scales with Minion stats.

[b]Vessel of The Serrated Claw [/b](Focus) - Summoned Zombies inflict Bleed equal to 15% of their damage dealt on hit.

[b]Vessel of The Smouldering Heart [/b](Focus) - Summoned Fireflies inflict 15% Burn for 2.5 seconds on hit, up to 75% Burn. Burn damage now only scales with Minion stats.

notes.notes:
Go make some food, grab a drink, and enjoy the largest patch notes in Rune Knights history. Also make sure to read [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1101400/view/3407555623445962379]PART 2[/url] of the patch notes for Talent changes and other updates.

Quick note: Existing characters might look a bit weird due to the new customization system and models. Visit the Hairdresser just behind where you spawn in Town to update your character's appearance.

If you get lost in the sauce, come get some help in our Discord: https://discord.gg/AAN6TCsmnH

[h1]EQUIPMENT CHANGES[/h1]
[h2]NEW GEAR SLOTS - GLOVES AND BELT[/h2]
These 2 new gear slots both provide new skills, for a new total of 8. The action bar has been redesigned to show 5 keys at once, and pressing Ctrl (your Modifier key is configurable in Hotkey settings, and you can change between hold and toggle behavior in Gameplay settings) switches your Q, E, and R skills to your 6th, 7th, and 8th skills. All skills can be moved freely with drag and drop.

Gloves roll double strength offensive implicits.

[h2]ENCHANTS[/h2]
Enchants imbue an armor piece with special effects. Enchants cannot be applied to Legendary items, jewelry, or belts.

[b]Weapon Enchants [/b]- For Physical Weapons and Shields. You can buy Level 1 Enchants for 1H Weapons and up to Level 2 Enchants for 2H Weapons from Binder.

[list]
[*] [b]Fire [/b]- Physical Hits Ignite for X% of the damage inflicted
[*] [b]Ice [/b]- Physical Hits apply a X% Chill for 3 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.
[*] [b]Lightning [/b]- Physical Hits have a 30% chance to chain lightning to 2 additional targets for X% of the damage.
[*] [b]Blood [/b]- Physical Hits restore X Health over 5 seconds.
[*] [b]Enfeeble [/b]- Physical Hits reduce the target's damage by X% for 3 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.
[*] [b]Sunder [/b]- Physical Hits increase damage taken by the target by X% for 3 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.
[*] [b]Serrated [/b]- Physical Hits Bleed for X% of the damage inflicted.
[*] [b]Toxic [/b]- Physical Hits apply X stack(s) of Poison.
[/list]

[b]Skill Enchants [/b]- For Armor (excluding belts and jewelry) and Caster Weapons. These enchants affect the skill granted by the item. Can buy level 2 Enchants for Staffs and Level 1 Enchants for Focuses and Armor from Binder. 

[list]
[*] [b]Increased Area [/b]- Increases the size of non-aura area effects of this skill by X%.
[*] [b]Reduced Cooldown [/b]- Reduces the cooldown of this skill by X%.
[*] [b]Reduced Resource Cost [/b]- Reduces resource costs of this skill by X%.
[*] [b]Increased Duration [/b]- Increases the duration of the effect of this skill by X%. (Note: Poison's duration cannot be increased.)
[/list]

Enchanted Gear can drop from bosses, and these dropped enchants are significantly stronger than those craftable at Binder.

[h2]ORDER INFLUENCE[/h2]
Items can drop with influence from one of the world's Knight Orders. Items with these influences roll mods under the order's influence more often than normal, can roll implicit and explicit mods that are normally impossible to roll, and roll mods affected by the influence one tier higher than normal, however, mods that are not under the order's influence are rolled one tier lower.

Influence can also be added to equipment with a new item called a [b]Sphere of Influence[/b]. Binder can use a [b]Sphere of Influence [/b]to add the influence of any Knight Order to an item. [b]Spheres of Influence [/b]are available as a quest reward for all quests, and can drop from any boss.

[h2]FLASKS REWORK[/h2]
The original Flask has been split into 2 Flasks: [b]Health Flask [/b](Default: 1 or D-Pad Down) and [b]Utility Flask [/b](Default: 2 or D-Pad Up). [b]Health Flasks [/b]always heal for 30% of your Maximum Health. [b]Utility Flasks [/b]can be heavily customized with many different effects using Utility Flask Points. All level 1 characters start with 1 Utility Flask Point and gain an additional point at levels 10, 20, and 30. Visit Binder in Town to customize your Utility Flask. New drops will refill Health and Utility Flasks separately, and killing enemies will slowly refill both Flasks.

The "Flask Target" function has been removed.

Hotkey customizations may need to be reapplied.

[h1]NEW ENEMIES[/h1]
[h2]LOOT GOBLINS[/h2]
Each encounter on Invasion maps has a 10% chance to spawn a loot goblin. Loot goblins are cowardly hoarders who flee at the first sign of danger. Goblins will flee to other nearby encounters and spawn as many enemies as they can in their wake to protect themselves and their horde.

[b]Crafting Goblin [/b]- 10 Runestones, lots of crafting items
[b]Legendary Gear Goblin [/b]- 1 Legendary Gear Piece
[b]Enchanted Goblin [/b]- 2 Enchanted Gear Pieces
[b]Gamba Goblin [/b]- 5 Gamba Currency drops

[h2]GAMBLING[/h2]
A new merchant has come to town. The Gambler will allow you to exchange Gamba currency in exchange for a random item of your choice. Items from The Gambler can roll Influenced, Enchanted, Legendary, or with very high mod tiers. Regular equipment rules apply (Legendary items still cannot be enchanted).

[h2]SHRINES[/h2]
Each encounter on randomly generated maps has a 10% chance to spawn a Shrine. Shrines apply a powerful buff to all allies for 30 seconds when destroyed. 

[h1]25 NEW SKILLS[/h1]
[b]Blood Leshen Pact Summon [/b]- Summon a blood leshen to fight for you. Attacks from range. Hold Left Alt while casting to dismiss.
Pact Effect: You and all minions restore 10 Health over 5 seconds on Hit. Minion duration increased by 10%.
Requires a Staff or Focus equipped

[b]Summon Greater Spider [/b]- Summon a greater spider to fight for you. Cannot be pushed by enemies. Hold Left Alt while casting to dismiss.
Mana Cost: 500
Cooldown: 8s

[b]Summon Greater Zombie [/b]- Summon a greater zombie to fight for you. Cannot be pushed by enemies. Hold Left Alt while casting to dismiss.
Mana Cost: 500
Cooldown: 8s

[b]Bat Swarm [/b]- Summon a swarm of bats upon your foes, dealing 35% combined weapon damage to all targets in its path. Damage scales with Minion Damage instead of Bonus Damage.
Mana Cost: 40
Cooldown: 0.75s
Range: 1500
Requires a Staff or Focus equipped

[b]Fulfill Pact [/b]- Entangle with your Pact Minion and attempt to fulfill the pact between you. While Entangled and within 1000 range, you transfer 10% of your maximum health per second to your Pact Minion. Sustaining this transfer without interruption for 10 seconds fulfills the pact, granting your minion Pact Vigor. Pact Vigor increases Total Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed by 30%. Pact Vigor lasts for 5 seconds after the transfer is stopped. Activate again to disentangle.
Requires a Staff or Focus equipped

[b]Necrosis [/b]- Cast necrotic energy that consumes your foes life. Deals 50% spell damage per second for 10 seconds.
Mana Cost: 150
Cooldown: 2s
Requires a Staff or Focus equipped

[b]Arcane Bolt [/b]- Cast a bolt of arcane energy that applies 1 stack of Arcane Resonance to the target for 6 seconds. 3 stacks of Arcane Resonance causes the target to unleash the resonating arcane energy in a burst that deals 100% spell damage and applies 1 stack of Arcane Resonance to all nearby targets.
Mana Cost: 70
Cooldown: 0.75s
Requires a Staff or Focus equipped

[b]Arcane Nova [/b]- Create an arcane nova around you which applies 2 stacks of Arcane Resonance to all targets for 6 seconds. 3 stacks of Arcane Resonance causes the target to unleash the resonating arcane energy in a burst that deals 100% spell damage and applies 1 stack of Arcane Resonance to all nearby targets.
Mana Cost: 250
Cooldown: 3s
Requires a Staff equipped

[b]Call Lightning [/b]- Call down lightning that deals 250% spell damage to a large area after a short delay.
Mana Cost: 200
Cooldown: 8s
Requires a Staff equipped

[b]Fire Quiver [/b]- Toggle. While active, all arrows are imbued with fire and inflict Burn on impact, dealing 15% combined weapon damage per second for 3 seconds. Burn stacks up to 75% combined weapon damage per second.
Mana Cost: 20 Mana per Arrow

[b]Lightning Quiver [/b]- Toggle. While active, all arrows are imbued with lightning and create chain lightning on impact, dealing 30% combined weapon damage to up to 2 additional targets.
Mana Cost: 35 Mana per Arrow

[b]Arcane Nova Arrow [/b]- Fires an arrow that explodes with arcane energy, dealing 150% weapon damage to all nearby targets.
Mana Cost: 150
Stamina Cost: 75
Cooldown: 8s

[b]Toxic Rain [/b]- Fire a marking arrow that calls down a hail of toxic arrows where it impacts, inflicting 2 stacks of Poison per second to all enemies in the area. Lasts for 3 seconds.
Mana Cost: 200
Stamina Cost: 150
Cooldown 10s

[b]Blight Arrow [/b]- Fires an arrow that inflicts a deadly blight on the target which deals damage over time. Deals 60% weapon damage damage per second for 10 seconds.
Mana Cost: 130
Stamina Cost: 130
Cooldown: 10s

[b]Hook Chain [/b]- Throw a chain and latch onto the first enemy hit, dealing 150% combined weapon damage. If the target is a Normal or Elite enemy, they are pulled to you. If the target is a Boss, you are pulled to them.
Stamina Cost: 75
Cooldown: 5s
Range: 2500

[b]Hallow Weapons [/b]- Call upon the divine to bless your weapons with overwhelming power. Melee attacks deal 50% more Resilience Damage for 6 seconds.
Mana Cost: 150
Cooldown: 10s
Requires a Sword, Axe, or Mace equipped.

[b]Arc Slash [/b]- Spin and deal 150% melee weapon damage to all nearby enemies.
Stamina Cost: 130
Cooldown: 2.5s
Requires a 1H Sword, Axe, or Mace equipped

[b]Poison Trap [/b]- Spawn a Poison Trap. On activation, applies 4 stacks of Poison to nearby targets and covers the area in toxic miasma for 7.5 seconds. Enemies within the miasma receive 1 additional stack of Poison per second. Max 1 Poison Trap. Trap becomes armed after 2 seconds. Hold Left Alt while casting to dismiss.
Mana Reservation Cost: 200
Cooldown: 5s
Requires a Focus or Staff equipped

[b]Emberlash Stance [/b]- Deliver a vicious uppercut, dealing 200% unarmed damage and igniting targets for the same damage over 5 seconds. Enter Emberlash Stance for 8 seconds, causing your melee hits to Ignite the target for 20% of the damage dealt over 5 seconds. Only one Stance can be active at a time.
Mana Cost: 100
Stamina Cost: 100
Cooldown: 4s
Only usable while Unarmed

[b]Viperfang Stance [/b]- Quickly dash forward and strike an enemy. Deals 100% unarmed damage and inflicts 5 stacks of Poison. Enter Viperfang Stance for 6 seconds, causing your melee hits to inflict 1 stack of Poison. Can interrupt current action. Only one Stance can be active at a time.
Mana Cost: 100
Stamina Cost: 100
Cooldown: 4s
Only usable while Unarmed

[b]Rockfist Stance [/b]- Smash the ground, dealing 100% unarmed damage to nearby targets and inflicting heavy Resilience Damage. Enter Rockfist Stance for 6 seconds, increasing your Resilience Damage by 30% and decreasing your damage taken by 15%. Only one Stance can be active at a time.
Mana Cost: 100
Stamina Cost: 100
Cooldown: 4s
Only usable while Unarmed

[b]Thunderstrike Stance [/b]- Strike a target for 125% unarmed damage and create chain lightning that deals 65% unarmed damage to up to 4 additional targets. Enter Thunderstrike Stance for 6 seconds, causing your melee hits to create chain lightning for 30% of the inflicted damage to up to 2 additional targets. Only one Stance can be active at a time.
Mana Cost: 100
Stamina Cost: 100
Cooldown: 4s
Only usable while Unarmed

[b]Snowstorm Stance [/b]- Slam the ground with a savage rush of cold, dealing 75% unarmed damage to nearby targets and Chilling them 20% for 3 seconds. Enter Snowstorm Stance for 8 seconds, causing your melee hits to inflict a stacking 5% Chill on the target for 2 seconds. Chill stacks up to 5 times. Only one Stance can be active at a time.
Mana Cost: 100
Stamina Cost: 100
Cooldown: 4s
Only usable while Unarmed

[b]Phase Shift [/b]- Phase violently between dimensions, dealing 100% combined weapon damage to nearby targets. You gain Phased, causing you to ignore enemy collision and increase your movement speed by 50% for 1.5 seconds. When you lose Phased, you deal damage again.
Mana Cost: 125
Cooldown: 6s

[b]Bestow Favor [/b]- Cast an orb that bestows all the effects of your Utility Flask to all allied players in an area on impact. Consumes 1 Utility Flask use.
Mana Cost: 75
Cooldown: 1s
Requires a Staff or Focus equipped

[h2]NEW LEGENDARIES[/h2]
10 New Legendaries added to the global drop pool

[h2]CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION[/h2]
A new merchant has come to town. The Hairdresser will allow you to change your character's appearance for free.

Characters now have many more customization options.

Gear now comes in many new styles.

[h2]MINIMAP UPGRADE[/h2]
Fog of war has been added.
Pressing Tab (default) will toggle a large minimap showing the whole area you've explored.

[h2]EQUIPMENT LOCKING[/h2]
Ctrl + Shift click to toggle equipment's lock state. While locked, it cannot be affected by crafting items, offered for trade, sold, or broken.

[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[h2]RESISTANCE REWORK[/h2]
Enemies now have natural resistance penetration equal to their level, and enemy damage has been rebalanced around net 0 resistance. Resistance mods now grant 0.3% resistance per mod level.

[b]Dev comment[/b]: In easy terms, this means that if you have 30% resistance, level 30 enemies will hit you for exactly the intended amount. 20% resistance against level 30 enemies will cause their damage to you to be increased by 10%, and 40% resistance against the same enemies will decrease their damage to you by 10%. This solves a few issues: Glass cannon builds are now more viable, as 0% resistance against level 30 enemies creates a 30% increase in their damage to you (the previous system would punish this with a 300% increase in damage). It's no longer possible for a single resistance mod to overcap you and feel like a portion of the mod is wasted. Tank builds now have more room for expression in their stats instead of being limited to the same 75% cap that most other builds were required to meet.

[h2]STATS OVERHAUL[/h2]
[b]Enhancement has been removed. [/b]
Mods now roll in tiers, which provide a bonus or penalty to mod level. Gear dropped by stronger enemies is more likely to have higher tier mods. High tier mods can also roll via crafting items, but the chance is far less likely. New crafting items have been added which increase the likelihood of high tier mods.

[b]Existing mods on gear will be reset to the gear's level (max 30).[/b]

[h2]NEW CRAFTING ITEMS[/h2]
Favored Crafting Items - Favored versions of existing crafting items function similarly to their non-favored counterparts, but with massively increased chances for exceptional outcomes.
[list]
[*] [b]Favored Runestone[/b]
[*] [b]Favored Fool's Gamble[/b]
[*] [b]Divine Will has been renamed to Favored Twist of Fate[/b]
[*] [b]Favored Crescendo[/b]
[/list]
These drop exclusively from boss-type enemies. Chance to drop is increased massively in Captain (50% increase) and Commander (100% increase) difficulties.

[b]Course Correction Rework [/b]- Shuffles mod tiers among existing stats. Randomly lowers the tier of a single mod by 1.
[b]Course Correction [/b]can now be purchased from the Merchant in Town (again).

[h2]BOWS[/h2]
Removed the 2 variations of bows (high damage/slow attack speed variant and low damage/high attack speed variant) and replaced them with a single improved version.

[h2]SHIELDS[/h2]
Max Shield Block % now increases with Equipment Level. 18% max at level 1, 35% max at level 30.
Shield implicits now roll naturally at double strength. Modifying the implicit with crafting items will reset it to normal values.

[h2]MODS[/h2]
Boot implicit mods no longer roll at double strength. Movement Speed mod scaling has been increased to compensate.

[b]Health Regen, Lower Mana Cost, Lower Stamina Cost, and Minion Health are no longer available without influence.[/b]

Health Regen can now only roll as an implicit mod. [b]Existing Health Regen explicit mods will be randomly rerolled.[/b]

Cooldown Reduction scaling reduced by roughly 50%.

[h2]ITEMS[/h2]
[b]Swarmcaller Rework [/b]- Applies Horde to Summon Spider when granted by this item.
[b]Viscera Rework [/b]- Melee hits restore 7.5 Health over 5 seconds. Lifesteal effects heal 10% faster.
[b]Decimator Rework [/b]- Sunder now causes targets to take 10% increased damage from all sources. Maximum Sunder stacks becomes 1.
[b]Spire of Teurok [/b]- Proc chance reduced from 50% to 40%. Additional projectile damage reduced from 50% to 40%.
[b]Stormblade [/b]- Chain lightning effect now chains 2 times, down from 4. Dual wielding now increases chance to proc Godcaller to 40%, down from 60%.
[b]Hellfire Sanctuary [/b]- Shield now blocks 50% of damage from the next hit.
[b]Meteor Forge Rework [/b]- Ignites nearby targets for 35% weapon damage per second for 3 seconds.
[b]Song of Fire [/b]- Casting Firebolt causes your next Frostbolt within 1 second to explode and Burn nearby enemies for 10% spell damage per second for 2.5 seconds.
[b]Song of Ice [/b]- Casting Frostbolt causes your next Firebolt within 1 second to burst with cold, Chilling nearby enemies for 10% for 1 second.
[b]The Ordained [/b]- Renamed to [b]Tempest Oath[/b]. Blessed effect removed.

[b]Penance [/b]- Price reduced from 200 to 150 gold.
[b]Absolution [/b]- Price reduced from 6000 to 4000 gold.

[h2]ENEMIES[/h2]

notes.title: Resilience Combat Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RlOersn.gif[/img]

[h1]RESILIENCE[/h1]
The previous hitstun system has been removed and replaced with Resilience. All Hits also damage a target's Resilience. When Resilience reaches 0, the target becomes staggered for a moment and their Resilience resets to full. Tougher creatures have more Resilience. After 4 seconds without taking Resilience Damage, Resilience will quickly regenerate. Attacks blocked by a shield do not affect Resilience.

[i]Dev Note: If you're familiar with Dark Souls' Poise System, this is similar with the addition of Resilience meters being visible to the player.[/i]
[h2]ENEMY AND MINION RESILIENCE[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gain 10% increased Resilience per level
[*] Deal 1% more Resilience Damage with their attacks per level
[*] Enemies gain 50% Total Resilience per additional player in party
[/list]
[h2]RESILIENCE NOTES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players have 100 Base Resilience.
[*] Player's base Resilience Damage is equal to 5% of their combined base weapon damage. While Dual Wielding, Base Resilience Damage is decreased by 25% (because it's a lot).
[*] Spells inflict much less Resilience Damage
[*] Lightning skills inflict more Resilience Damage
[*] Modifiers to Total Damage also increase Resilience Damage
[*] Modifiers to % Damage Reduction also decrease incoming Resilience Damage (Frost Shield, Adamantine, etc.)
[*] Blockbreakers now deal twice as much Resilience Damage as a normal attack.
[*] Crits increase Resilience Damage by 10%
[*] Supercrits increase Resilience Damage by 20%
[*] Training dummies now have 100 Base Resilience for testing
[*] Enemies that were immune to hitstun now have high Resilience instead.
[/list]
[h1]BALANCE[/h1]
[h2]STATS[/h2]
Hitstun Resistance no longer rolls on gear. Existing mods will be randomly rerolled.
[h2]SKILLS[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Block[/b] - Parries no longer hitstun the target. Instead, parries now reflect the attack's Resilience Damage back to the attacker.
[*] [b]Calamitous Strike [/b]- Charge up an explosive punch that launches you forward, deals up to 300% unarmed damage to enemies in an area and grants you a shield which will block the next attack if a target is hit. Damage and area scale with charge. Inflicts heavy Resilience Damage.
[*] [b]Poison Nova Arrow [/b]- Now applies 2 stacks of Poison, up from 1.
[*] [b]Magic Missile [/b]- Damage per missile reduced from 40% to 35% spell damage.
[*] [b]Dual Wield Standard Attack [/b]- Now deals 75% combined weapon damage, up from 50%.
[*] All skills which inflicted a guaranteed hitstun : Now deals heavy Resilience Damage instead of applying a guaranteed hitstun.
[/list]
[h2]TALENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Balanced [/b]- Resilience Damage received is reduced by 10%.
[*] [b]Expertise [/b]- Your attacks deal 3 additional Resilience Damage.
[*] [b]Pressure Points [/b]- While Unarmed, Melee Hits deal additional Resilience Damage equal to 5% of your critical strike chance. Maximum 10 additional Resilience damage.
[*] [b]Sturdy [/b]- Max Health and Resilience increased by 25%.
[*] [b]Hulking [/b]- Gain 5% Bonus Damage for each 100 Max Health. Physical attacks deal 20% more Resilience Damage.
[*] [b]Alert [/b]- Resilience starts to regenerate 25% sooner and recovers 25% faster.
[/list]
[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Kensai not working.
[*] Potential fix for aberrant target acquisition/threat behavior.
[/list]

notes.title: Talent Tree Functionality Changes
notes.notes:
TL;DR: You get 6 more talent points for passive stat bonuses and a free Absolution from Brother Orrian for characters that have reached level 5.

Old system: 4 points in passives allows you to spend your 5th point on a T1 talent. 9 points of total investment in the tree allow you to spend your 10th point on a T1 or T2 talent.

New system: 5 points in passives will allow you select a T1 talent without spending a talent point. 10 points in passives will allow you to select a T1 or T2 talent without spending a talent point.

The end result of this change is that characters will have 6 more talent points to spend on passive stat bonuses at level 30. The number of T1 and T2 talents characters can have is unaffected. 

It's easier to give everyone a free respec than to implement a way to make these changes retroactive, so all characters that have reached level 5 will receive 1 free Absolution from Brother Orrian in Town.

notes.title: Launch Issues - Price Changes
notes.notes:
Hey fam,

Here's the deal, I messed up the launch. I had been planning to launch Rune Knights as a regularly priced game, and pulled the trigger on release without setting this up properly. The game launched as Free To Play and I essentially sabotaged my own Early Access launch.

I know this is going to be upsetting for many of you, but in order to "reset" my bungled launch, I've decided to remove access to the game for everyone and re-launch at $9.99. Your support from purchasing goes toward feeding myself, my family, and my cat Simon (pics below).
